setting.help: After installing, MCP is available at: http://<your-odoo-host>:<port>/mcp/sse?db=<database>. In Cursor/Claude use mcp-remote with --transport sse-only and --allow-http.

Choose how the AI assistant authenticates with this Odoo instance. 'Sign in with Odoo (OAuth)' is the recommended native method: one URL, each user logs in with their own Odoo account, no keys to copy. Choose 'Other methods' only for clients that cannot use OAuth.
The modern, native way to connect — no API keys, no config file, no mcp-remote.

ol.li: In Claude Desktop, open Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector.
Paste the connector URL below into the URL field. Leave Client ID and Client Secret empty.
Save, then click Connect: a browser opens and the user signs in with their own Odoo account and clicks Allow.

div.p: The assistant then runs with exactly that user's Odoo permissions — nothing more. Each user gets their own separate, correctly-scoped session.

setting.string: Connector URL — copy this into Claude
setting.help: Paste into Claude Desktop → Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector → URL. Leave Client ID and Client Secret empty.
Watch how to add a custom connector in Claude Desktop and sign in.
OAuth discovery is requested without a database name.

div.p: Sign-in discovery is fetched without a database name, so this server must be able to resolve a default database. This is automatic when the host serves a single database. On a multi-database server, set db_name = <database> (or a matching dbfilter) in odoo.conf, otherwise the login flow cannot start.

setting.help: Legacy connection methods for clients that cannot use OAuth. Pick one — its own configuration appears below.
If checked, clients must send a valid User or Admin token. If not checked, no token is required (read-only access).
Give this token to standard users. Claude will only be able to search and read data (no create, edit or delete).
⚠️ Give only to managers or admins. With this token Claude can create, edit and delete records (orders, invoices, etc.). Use with care and ensure backups.
The login (email) of the Odoo user the LLM will operate as. The LLM will respect this user's access rights and permissions.
The password of the Odoo user. It will be stored in system parameters.
If checked, the LLM can create, edit and delete records. If unchecked, only read operations are permitted.
Verify that the configured username and password are valid for this Odoo database.
Each person connects with their own native Odoo API key. The LLM then operates as that user and can do exactly what the user is allowed to do in Odoo — nothing more. No shared admin token is used.

div.p: Each user generates their own key in Preferences → Account Security → New API Key (top-right user menu → My Profile, then the "Account Security" tab). Admins can create a key on behalf of a user via "Log in as" that user.
The client must send the key on every request, in any of these forms:
Write access follows the user's own Odoo permissions: read-only users can only read; users without delete rights cannot delete, and so on.

setting.help: Builds the JSON block to paste into your Claude Desktop / Cursor MCP client configuration file, using this Odoo instance's URL, the current database name, and the selected Authentication method. Click to regenerate whenever you change the base URL, switch database, or change the authentication method (save first).

setting.string: How to find / edit the client config file
setting.help: Opens a short tutorial that shows where Claude Desktop / Cursor store their MCP configuration file and how to edit it.

Copy this 'odoo' entry and paste it inside the "mcpServers": { ... } object of your MCP client configuration file (e.g. claude_desktop_config.json), next to any other servers you already have. Replace any <PASTE-...> placeholder with your real value: for Per-User API Key use your own key (Preferences → Account Security → New API Key); for shared tokens use the User or Admin token generated above.

setting.help: If set, all MCP operations will run in this company's context by default. Claude can override this per-tool call using company_id, or per-request via ?company_id= or X-Odoo-Company header. Leave empty for no default (multi-company: all companies visible).
Passed to MCP clients in serverInfo.description. Example: 'CRM and inside sales; leads, opportunities, teams; no manufacturing.' Installed apps are still auto-detected.

field.placeholder: Short description of this Odoo database for the AI...

setting.help: If checked, the connected LLM can ONLY use the dashboard tools (list, get, schema help, create, update, add/remove widget, delete). All other tools — ORM read/write, raw SQL, CRM lead generation, capability discovery — are hidden from tools/list and refused on tools/call. Use this to lock the assistant to dashboard work only.

Enable lead-generation and mailing-campaign 'from a brief' features. When ON, you get a 'Claude Lead Brief' button on CRM > Leads, a 'Claude brief' button on Email Marketing > Mailings, Claude Briefs menus under each app's Configuration, and Claude can use the lead-gen / CRM / mailing MCP tools. When OFF, those menus, buttons, and tools are hidden and refused. (CRM and Mass Mailing are dependencies of this module and stay installed in either case.)

Let the connected LLM manage user access rules in plain language: hide menus, restrict create/edit/delete on models, hide or make fields readonly, apply record-level domains, block whole apps, control chatter/export visibility, and create users. When ON, the access-management MCP tools are exposed to the assistant in addition to its normal capabilities. When OFF (default), those tools are hidden and refused.

Let the connected LLM optimise your website for search engines. When ON, Claude can audit every page, product and blog post (meta title/description length, duplicate titles, missing OpenGraph image, noindex or unpublished pages, bad URLs, missing or multiple <h1>, images without alt text, thin content), then fix what it finds: write meta tags, rename URLs with an automatic 301 redirect, set alt text and headings, manage redirects and robots.txt, refresh the sitemap, and set the canonical domain, Google Search Console and Analytics keys. When OFF (default), those tools are hidden and refused. Requires Odoo's Website app.
setting.div: The Website app is not installed, so the SEO tools have nothing to work on. They stay visible to the assistant and will tell you to install it.
